region.scope: Adityapur Industrial Area, Gamharia and Jamshedpur industrial belt

purpose: Regional machine-knowledge seed set for GridMind. Directly evidenced equipment is separated from process-derived archetypes. This dataset must not be interpreted as a claim that every listed machine exists at every factory.

evidence_policy.direct: Equipment/process explicitly documented by a named factory or authoritative regional source.
evidence_policy.inferred: Machine archetype inferred from a documented manufacturing process or regional industry concentration; requires site-level confirmation before machine-specific diagnostics.
evidence_policy.diagnostic_rule: No machine-specific diagnostic may be enabled solely from inferred regional presence.

sources.title: Adityapur Small Industries Association automotive components directory
sources.evidence: Regional automotive-component manufacturing concentration and named enterprises.

sources.title: DC MSME Jamshedpur industrial cluster/status report
sources.evidence: Regional concentration in automotive, metal fabrication, general engineering, foundry/casting, stamping, rubber/plastic, electrical machinery and related sectors.

sources.title: Empire Auto Adityapur infrastructure
sources.evidence: Named equipment and capacities at an Adityapur forging/manufacturing plant.

sources.title: Empire Auto forging equipment
sources.evidence: Electric screw press, gravity drop hammers, screw presses, trimming presses, induction billet heater, oil-fired furnace and shot blasting.

sources.title: Empire Auto machining equipment
sources.evidence: CNC turning, VMC, bandsaw, grinding, conventional lathes, column drilling, centering/facing.

sources.title: Empire Auto heat-treatment equipment
sources.evidence: Box normalizing furnace and pit furnaces.

sources.title: Ramkrishna Forgings plant locations and divisions
sources.evidence: Plants in Gamharia/Jamshedpur and Adityapur; CNC division identified at Plant III & IV.

sources.title: Ramkrishna Forgings manufacturing processes and facilities
sources.evidence: Hammer/upset forging, heat treatment, shot blasting, CNC machining, gear cutting, HMC/VMC, broaching, shaving, shaping, annealing, quenching, induction hardening, ring rolling and drilling.

sources.title: Ramkrishna Forgings Plant III & IV ISO certificate
sources.evidence: Open/closed-die forgings and finished machined components at Adityapur Plant III & IV.

sources.title: Tata Motors Jamshedpur manufacturing-unit information
sources.evidence: Jamshedpur engine, axle and automotive component manufacturing context.
